notes.title: Another World - 20th Anniversary Edition - Game Update
notes.notes:
Dear community, dear fans,

Last month, we have updated the PC VERSION of Another World - 20th Anniversary for the first time on Steam.

Eric Chahi and our friends at Goblinz have developed this update to make this version similar to the console versions.

- All backgrounds of the game are now in 1080p 
- Fixing gameplay scripting  
- Fixing minor bug
- Adding 8 new languages :  Simplified Chinese - Brazilian Portuguese - Japanese - Korean - Portuguese - Polish - Russian and Turkish 

Thank you again for your support, and do not hesitate to reach our technical support to report any issue: support@thedigitalounge.com

Stay safe,

Digital Lounge Team

notes.title: Another World out now on Xbox One, PlayStation version mysteriously delayed
notes.notes: The 20th anniversary edition of Another World was originally supposed to arrive today on Sony platforms. However, it appears that the game has been stealth delayed to a future date. Meanwhile, the Xbox One version of the PC classic was suddenly been released earlier today.
